<script>
(function () {
  // Image gallery
  var sections = document.querySelectorAll('.ds-venue-section');
  sections.forEach(function (section) {
    var imgs    = section.querySelectorAll('.ds-venue-img');
    var dots    = section.querySelectorAll('.ds-dot');
    var prevBtn = section.querySelector('.ds-arrow--prev');
    var nextBtn = section.querySelector('.ds-arrow--next');
    var total   = imgs.length;
    var current = 0;

    function goTo(i) {
      current = (i + total) % total;
      imgs.forEach(function (img, j) { img.classList.toggle('ds-img--active', j === current); });
      dots.forEach(function (dot, j) { dot.classList.toggle('ds-dot--active', j === current); });
    }

    dots.forEach(function (dot, i) { dot.addEventListener('click', function () { goTo(i); }); });
    if (prevBtn) prevBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goTo(current - 1); });
    if (nextBtn) nextBtn.addEventListener('click', function () { goTo(current + 1); });
  });
})();
</script>
